job.job_description:
Were Hiring: Databricks & AI Engineer

Experience: 4+ Years
Locations: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai / Pune

Required Skills:

Databricks, PySpark & Delta Lake
Python, SQL & MLflow
AI/ML, RAG & LLMs
LangChain, LangGraph, Agentic AI & MCP
Vector Databases
Azure / AWS / GCP
MLOps, CI/CD, Docker & Kubernetes
Data Engineering & ETL/ELT Pipelines

Candidates with hands-on experience in Databricks, Data Engineering, and modern AI technologies are encouraged to apply.




Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at thulasi.d@tekskills.in
